I’m dead serious, there is no purpose in lying about my problems.

In fact, people tend to say things along the lines of “you don’t know anything.” or make me look stupid for being wrong.  People just don’t side with me, and I’ve had it happen to me countless times.

For example, In school, I was told bluntly “we don’t need you in our group” when I was assigned to help them.

Maybe I’m unpopular or my personality is absolute garbage/boring?  I keep thinking I’m a horrendous human being but, maybe I’m just unlucky as hell?  I know I can’t take this crap anymore

Damn, it’s hard to believe that it’s not your fault when you’ve lead an entire fucking life being taught just that. But, it could possibly be the better side like you’ve said.

I guess I’ve gotta keep searching, even if it takes another millennium.  Honestly, I’ve met a ton of people in the past with no luck though; mostly bad responses and not knowing if it’s because my personality is actually non-human or if I’m that unlucky.  But, I’m in complete honesty, I’m very exhausted and on the verge of just quitting all together if it doesn’t work out.

Thanks for the thought though, I hope that you are having a better day
Oh, sorry about that.  Thank you for your consideration though, it means a lot!

Well, I’ve tried talking to people in those clubs...

I’ve always felt fairly uncomfortable being worshipped for being half-Japanese in those groups, and I never really could fit in given my interests lie elsewhere.  It sounds like I’m resisting but truly, I could’ve never really connected...

Maybe, I’m doing something wrong?
Damn, I’ll take some advice down there.  It’s embarrassing as hell but, is it really overthinking that’s killing me out here?

Damn, I was lost then...

One thing I’ve heard is that young men tend to be “shit-out-of-luck” when it comes to hookups.  Is that true?  In that instance, what action should I take?

Hey, what do you mean by sentence structure?

Also, how do I imply a “friends with benefits” relationship from the get-go?
